search.developerUnlockedHint: Developer page unlocked. It is highly recommended not to use it because it is mostly useless.

oldNavigation.title: Old Navigation Bar
oldNavigation.description: Bring back Old Navigation Bar that Roblox redesigned in 2025.

moreRoundedCorners.title: More rounded corners
moreRoundedCorners.description:
Makes game thumbnails, vertical menus and horizontal tabs more soften.

Roblox applies this by default to the horizontal tab in the Avatar page.

sidebar.title: Sidebar
sidebar.sizeDescription: Drag slider to choose the size of the sidebar.
sidebar.collapseMenuTitle: Full to Icon Only Collapse Button
sidebar.collapseMenuDescription: Adds a button for the sidebar to switch between full and icon-only size.
sidebar.contentListDescription: Remove items you do not want from the sidebar.
sidebar.contentEmptyHint: Open a Roblox page with the left navigation visible to detect sidebar items.
sidebar.alwaysShowCloseDescription: Forces Roblox's sidebar close/menu button to always be visible.
sidebar.expandSidebarOnHoverDescription: Keeps the sidebar icon-only until you hover over it, then expands to full size.
sidebar.eventsDescription: Brings back the Roblox Events in the sidebar deleted in 2024-2025 after Sidebar redesign.

friendStyling.title: Friend Styling Reimagined
friendStyling.description: Restyles the friends carousel with background and presence glow by offlinewealth

hideAgeBadge.title: Hide Age Rate Badge
hideAgeBadge.description: Hides new age rate badge, it is SELECT and KIDS sign near Roblox logo at the left top side.

profileRedesign.title: Profile Redesign
profileRedesign.description: Show all profile sections at once and adjust the header layout on profile pages.

hideExperiencesAds.title: Hide Experiences Ads on the Home Page

searchBan.enableDescription: Blocks Roblox discover searches for keywords you add below.
searchBan.title: Banned Search Words
searchBan.description: When a banned word is searched on Discover, results are hidden and an error screen is shown instead.
searchBan.emptyHint: No banned words yet. Add words above to block them from Discover search.

sync.title: Synchronization
sync.description: Copy, export, or import RoPrime settings as JSON file. You can edit the JSON in the preview.
sync.importFailed: Couldn't import this file. Choose a valid settings export file.
sync.resetDone: All settings were reset to defaults.

info.title: RoPrime
info.body:
RoPrime adds useful design-focused features to the Roblox website.

Test [GitHub](https://github.com/walway/RoPrime) test [Discord server](https://discord.gg/NjkRz5hUJH).

developer.title: Developer Tools
developer.description: This page is hidden by default. It is highly recommended not to use it because it is mostly useless.

customCss.title: Custom CSS
customCss.description: CSS you write here injects into every Roblox page while RoPrime is enabled.

cosmetics.enableDescription: Enable to see profile effect previews and equip options.
